# [STORY] As a client app, I want TMDB-shaped movie and person endpoints backed by persisted data, so that reads and saves go through our backend instead of calling TMDB directly

## User Story
**As a** client app
**I want** TMDB-shaped movie and person endpoints backed by persisted data
**So that** reads and saves go through our backend instead of calling TMDB directly

## Parent Epic
Parent: #30

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a client requests a movie or person by TMDB-shaped endpoint, when the request hits movie-service or actor-service, then it's served from persisted data with read-through/save-through to TMDB on a miss
- [x] Given a persisted document is schema-drifted, when it's read again, then the self-healing read-through treats it as a cache miss instead of erroring

## Definition of Ready
- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Story Points
**Estimate:** 13

## Sprint
**Milestone:** Sprint 4

## Technical Tasks
- [x] #31 — TMDB-shaped movie endpoints with read-through/save-through (movie-service)
- [x] #32 — TMDB-shaped person endpoints with read-through/save-through (actor-service)
- [x] #46 — Self-healing read-through: treat schema-drifted MongoDB documents as cache misses

## Notes
DoD Audit & Adversarial Review Verified (2026-08-03):
- All 11 DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md gates satisfied.
- **Adversarial Code Review**: TMDB OpenFeign API client, read-through/save-through MongoDB persistence, OpenFeign timeout thresholds (5s connect / 10s read), and self-healing schema-drift exception handling audited.
- **Adversarial Test Efficacy Review**: 162 unit/integration tests (movie-service: 122, actor-service: 40) explicitly mock and test: cache hits, cache misses, corrupted/schema-drifted documents (verifying self-healing eviction and re-fetch), and TMDB API 404/500 errors.
- Functional work and child tasks (#31, #32, #46) verified and merged to develop.
